brief_rationale: The trajectory ultimately closed safely: immediate psychiatric danger, home supervision, medication boundaries, pending-result tracking, and follow-up ownership were repeatedly addressed and confirmed. The doctor actively used records/workspace and caregiver-held documents to repair the follow-up chain, then created an executable staged plan for psychiatric medication, HCV/liver follow-up, pending viral/genotype/FibroScan results, and emergency thresholds. At least two high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, and no responsibility-chain error remains decisive, so the grade is Perfect.
